title: Remove background on celebration (post-Yes) screen

requirements.text: Remove the background from the post-Yes (celebration) screen so that after clicking the "Yes" button the celebration/section page does not show the app background/gradient.

quotes: still that background coming on secton page after clicking yes button but i just want to remove that bg from there

acceptanceCriteria: Given the user clicks the Yes button and the celebration screen is shown, the page background behind the celebration content is not the app gradient background.
The initial floating-particles background is not visible on the celebration screen.
No background styling regressions occur on the initial (pre-Yes) screen: it still displays the current background/animation as before.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook bootstrap/auth files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Do not change the celebration overlay animations (fireworks/sparkles/hearts), except as needed to ensure they are not mistaken for the removed background.
Do not add new pages or routing; only adjust existing post-Yes view styling.
